$comment: Machine-readable migration registry. The SessionStart hook reads it to decide whether a project's `configuredWith` marker sits below a version that introduced a REQUIRED migration. Written when a version is published — never inferred from the changelog prose. `required: true` means the project behaves differently, or stops working as documented, unless the developer acts; everything additive and opt-in is `required: false` and MUST NOT notify. Adding entries is the only supported way to make the startup notice fire.

migrations.title: Operating modes per repo (crew.json)
migrations.summary: A repo without crew.json keeps behaving exactly as before; adopting modes, metrics and the quality gate is opt-in.

migrations.title: Design capabilities, design memory and the configuration marker
migrations.summary: Additive: undeclared capabilities are simply unavailable and the roles say so. Running /crew:setup is optional and always asks before writing.
